---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature, profile, or workflow improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Be concrete — what is currently painful in your AI-driven development workflow?

## Proposed solution

Your idea for what `ai-check-template` should add or change. Reference specific files under `package-templates/` if relevant.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve this problem (other OSS, custom scripts, etc.) and why they fall short.

## Use case

Who benefits and how often. A concrete scenario is more useful than a generic capability statement.

## Roadmap fit

Which roadmap milestone does this fit into?

- [ ] v0.1.0 — fits within the manual-template scope
- [ ] v0.2.0 — requires CLI changes
- [ ] v0.3.0+ — requires reusable workflow or Composite Action
- [ ] Beyond v0.3.0
- [ ] Not sure — please advise

## Additional context

Anything else (screenshots, references to other OSS, links to articles, etc.).
